critical_decisions: The all_73 test using raw projection plus only three semantic overrides is not a frozen semantic oracle. It mixes authored palette contracts and arbitrary raw color conversion. Preserve its failed output as historical evidence, then split generic quantizer tests from explicit semantically proven palette tests.

Do not bless all current palette entries: current field_hover TrueColor differs from frozen INPUT_HOVER; accent_pressed/focus_ring/tints and syntax colors also have existing mismatches. Any correction requires component recipe regression evidence and frozen profile output proof.
A token may be used by incompatible reference contexts. Fix recipe ownership or introduce an additive semantic role when justified; changing one global color cannot repair all consumers.
Syntax correctness includes BOLD/ITALIC/UNDERLINED/reverse modifiers, not colors alone. Meter stale variants and backdrop transformations are similarly contextual.
staged_plan: Freeze pure raw-color conversion independently, retaining16M quantizer evidence and custom-role provenance tests. Do not modify authored palette defaults in that increment merely to make all_73 green.

Correct small proven recipe cohorts with authored profile values and actual buffer tests: first Button primary rest/hover/pressed and focus marker, then field hover, then syntax classes. Include explicit custom overrides and repeated/chained downgrade.

Resolve ambiguous backdrop, disabled backgrounds, active Grid cells and selection through separate component contracts. Preserve unresolved rows in the migration matrix; no claimed full palette or app parity.
Replace all_73 equality with independently documented profile fixtures for mapped semantics plus extension/default-policy tests. Do not copy candidate palette tables into expected output.
